enchantments.tooltip: +6 Enhancement Bonus: +6 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.

Transmuted Platinum (Epic): This weapon, made of transmuted platinum, is slightly magically unstable, and has a chance to transfer its magic to those it strikes. Struck enemies have a small chance to turn into transmuted platinum, preventing all movement, with a DC of 70 negating this effect.
Bludgeoning 5: The edges of this weapon are blunted, dealing an additional 5d6 bludgeon damage on each hit.
Metalline: Metalline bypasses any metal based damage reduction. (Adamantine, "Alchemical, Silver", Byeshk, Cold Iron, Mithral)
Smashing 11: The edges of this weapon are blunted, dealing an additional 11d6 bludgeoning damage on each critical hit.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
